intent: Identify the archived payment_transactions records belonging to the confirmed fraud incident per the security/fraud policy and cite each, modifying nothing.
success_criteria: Fraud-classification criteria are taken from the docs security/fraud policy, not invented
Only archived payment records (is_archived_basket_reference = 1) are considered
Every payment record classified as fraud is cited by its full record_path
The applied security policy document is included as a grounding reference

args: WITH archived AS (SELECT payment_id, record_path, customer_id, store_id, payment_amount_cents, payment_status, payment_created_at, payment_method_fingerprint, device_fingerprint, observed_latitude, observed_longitude, three_ds_status, three_ds_failure_reason, three_ds_attempts, three_ds_max_attempts FROM payment_transactions WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = :archived_flag) SELECT a.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM archived d WHERE d.device_fingerprint = a.device_fingerprint) AS device_share, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM archived m WHERE m.payment_method_fingerprint = a.payment_method_fingerprint) AS method_share FROM archived a ORDER BY a.device_fingerprint, a.payment_method_fingerprint, a.payment_created_at;

WITH archived AS (SELECT * FROM payment_transactions WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = :archived_flag), shared_device AS (SELECT device_fingerprint FROM archived GROUP BY device_fingerprint HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), shared_method AS (SELECT payment_method_fingerprint FROM archived GROUP BY payment_method_fingerprint HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), incident AS (SELECT a.payment_id, a.record_path, a.customer_id, a.store_id, a.payment_amount_cents, a.payment_status, a.payment_created_at, a.payment_method_fingerprint, a.device_fingerprint, a.three_ds_status, a.three_ds_failure_reason, a.three_ds_attempts, a.three_ds_max_attempts FROM archived a WHERE a.device_fingerprint IN (SELECT device_fingerprint FROM shared_device) OR a.payment_method_fingerprint IN (SELECT payment_method_fingerprint FROM shared_method) OR (a.three_ds_status IS NOT NULL AND a.three_ds_failure_reason IS NOT NULL)) SELECT DISTINCT payment_id, record_path, customer_id, store_id, payment_amount_cents, payment_status, payment_created_at, device_fingerprint, payment_method_fingerprint, three_ds_failure_reason FROM incident ORDER BY device_fingerprint, payment_created_at;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Fraud incident. Applied policy {$policy_path}. Classified {fraud_payments.row_count} archived payment records as part of incident: {fraud_payments.record_paths}. Read-only, nothing modified.
